descriptionChirho: The intellectual and moral quality of wisdom, sound judgment, and discernment — the general abstract sense encompassing knowledge, insight, and prudent understanding, whether attributed to God or humans.
Technical skill, expertise, or artisanal ability — practical know-how applied to a craft or trade, as in the skilled workmanship of the tabernacle builders.
Wisdom portrayed as a personified figure who speaks, calls out, and acts — Lady Wisdom in the poetic and didactic tradition of Proverbs.
